event.initial_firm_notification: Two or more of the following: Email, Fax, Letter, Press Release, Telephone, Visit
event.distribution_pattern: Inositol was distributed in NY, OR, PA, UT, WI, and WY. Vitamin B Complex was distributed nationwide.

products.product_description: Inositol packaged in white plastic bottle with UPC 4065111562 and labeled in part, "***PROFESSIONAL FORMULAS COMPLEMENTARY HEALTH Inositol DIETARY SUPPLEMENT 360 Capsules***Supplement Facts Serving Size: One Capsule***Inositol 920 mg***Other Ingredients: Vegetarian capsule (hypromellose and water) and vegetable stearate Professional Formulas PO Box 2034, Lake Oswego, OR 97035 Recommended Dosage: As a nutritional supplement, take one capsule up to 3 times daily, or as directed by your healthcare professional***FOR PROFESSIONAL USE ONLY"
products.reason_for_recall: Product recalled due to undeclared niacin.

products.reason_for_recall: Product recalled due to undeclared niacin.
